public_message: Rs.750 per tonne for 170t, and you still handle transport – take it or leave it.
private_reasoning: Seller's ask of Rs.900/t exceeds our ceiling of Rs.850/t, so we must counter. Our target is Rs.650/t; proposing Rs.750/t is a compromise that stays below our max while giving the seller a decent margin. We keep the volume at 170t to match our needs and retain seller-delivered logistics to avoid extra transport cost. This should keep the closed-loop deal alive.
